Science, like onions, ______ quietly or not at all.（work 三单）
They used ______ compare waistlines in sentence one.
The feed is forever ______ that everyone is failing.
一般现在时可把制度倾向写成近乎事实。
would 过去习惯必须加 to。
用 are always 抱怨：Institutions print posters whenever kitchens talk.
exercises.answer: Institutions are always printing posters when kitchens talk.

exercises.q: 用 that 三单：A market never sells in moderation.
exercises.answer: A market that never sells in moderation hires shame.

exercises.q: 用 would：The cook kept rice from drying every shift then.
exercises.answer: The cook would keep the rice from drying every shift.

exercises.q: 改错：A market that never sell in moderation hires shame.
exercises.answer: A market that never sells in moderation hires shame.

exercises.q: 改错：Would the cook to keep the rice from drying?
exercises.answer: Would the cook keep the rice from drying?

exercises.q: A syllabus that ____ phosphorus without an egg confuses naming with nourishing.
Samples ____ the night kitchen and still speak of 'the average body'.
Committees ____ forever listing micronutrients as luxury brands. (complaint)
Used to, hunger ____ incidental; cameras still stop first.
Onions ____ how kitchens draw on science: daily, or not at all.
The average textbook body ______ a statistical ghost.（remain 三单）
They used ______ launch purity panics after every yolk.
Policy is always ______ lighting for glucose.
used to be 可以接形容词。
一般现在时不能用于定义句。
用 used to be：Hunger was treated as incidental in the past.
用三单：A syllabus lists phosphorus without an egg.
exercises.answer: A syllabus that lists phosphorus without an egg confuses naming with nourishing.

exercises.q: 用 are forever 抱怨：Committees list micronutrients as brands.
exercises.answer: Committees are forever listing micronutrients as luxury brands.

exercises.q: 改错：A syllabus that list phosphorus confuses naming.
exercises.answer: A syllabus that lists phosphorus confuses naming.

exercises.q: 改错：Samples misses the night kitchen.

grammar.title: 定语从句：who / that / which / whom / whose / 介词+关系词
grammar.titleEn: Relative clauses: who, whom, whose, which/that, omission
grammar.usage:
who 引导定语从句，先行词是人。People who eat three apples a day...

拓展：that 人/物；which 物；whom 宾格；whose 所有格；介词+whom/which；宾语关系词可省；what 不是定语从句关系词（前面无先行词）。
限制性：无逗号，删了意思变。
notes: who 后动词与先行词一致。
what 不是定语从句（无先行词）。

examples.en: The girl who sits there packed eggs.
examples.cn: 坐在那儿的女孩打包了鸡蛋。

examples.en: People who eat three apples a day notice fibre.
examples.cn: 一天吃三个苹果的人会注意到纤维。

examples.en: People who avoid yolks out of fear miss cheap protein.
examples.cn: 因害怕而避开蛋黄的人错过便宜蛋白质。

examples.en: Those whom we cannot sample still eat.
examples.cn: 我们采样不到的人仍然在吃饭。

examples.en: Grandmothers on whom the service relies were never hired.
examples.cn: 这项服务所依赖的祖母们从未被雇用。

examples.en: Those whom we fed last are the test, not the average ghost.
examples.cn: 我们最后才喂到的人是检验，不是那个平均幽灵。

exercises.q: The girl ____ sits there is my sister.
I like teachers ____ eat with us.
The apple ____ is on the plate is yours.
The boy ____ bag is red packed eggs.
This is the cook ____ we thanked.
People ______ eat soup first feel full sooner.
The eggs ______ Mum boiled are still warm.
The friend ______ I walk with lives next door.
which 一般不指人。
whose 只能指人。
用 who 合并：The girl sits there. She is my sister.
exercises.answer: The girl who sits there is my sister.

exercises.q: 用 whose：The boy has a red bag. He packed eggs.
exercises.answer: The boy whose bag is red packed eggs.

exercises.q: 省略宾语关系词：This is the cook that we thanked.
exercises.answer: This is the cook we thanked.

exercises.q: 改错：The girl which sits there is my sister.
exercises.answer: The girl who sits there is my sister.

exercises.q: 改错：The boy who bag is red packed eggs.
exercises.answer: The boy whose bag is red packed eggs.

exercises.q: Students ____ sit up without hands after two weeks surprise the coach.
The stairs ____ we take are free.
The nurse to ____ we spoke checked pulses.
Anyone ____ craving sweets can start with an apple.
The eggs we ____ are a cheap protein. (omit pronoun)
exercises.explain: 省略 whom/that，不要再留 them。

exercises.q: People who ______ three apples a day notice water and fibre.
The gym ______ receipt is not a pulse disappointed her.
This is the soup with ______ we start. (which)
介词后指人常用 whom，不用 that。
省略关系词后还要保留 them。
用 to whom：We spoke to the nurse. She checked pulses.
exercises.answer: The nurse to whom we spoke checked pulses.

exercises.q: 用 whose 指物：The gym's receipt is not a pulse. It disappointed her.
exercises.answer: The gym whose receipt is not a pulse disappointed her.

exercises.q: 省略：The eggs that we boiled are cheap.
exercises.answer: The eggs we boiled are cheap.

exercises.q: 改错：The nurse to who we spoke checked pulses.
exercises.answer: The nurse to whom we spoke checked pulses.

exercises.q: 改错：The eggs we boiled them are cheap.
exercises.answer: The eggs we boiled are cheap.

exercises.q: People who ____ yolks out of fear miss a cheap protein.
exercises.explain: who 后动词与先行词一致。

exercises.q: Night workers ____ days the poster assumes do not exist.
The fibre ____ the apple offers is slower than a bun.
Anyone for ____ breakfast is a kettle still counts.
What they crave at 4 p.m. ____ skipped lunch, not character. (not a relative here)
Families who ______ on a diet after festivals often faint at 800 metres.
The vending machine to ______ we lose at 22:40 has lighting.
Children ______ stomachs hurt after fried chicken skipped the soup.
what 前面没有先行词，不是定语从句。
who 后的动词永远用复数。
用 whose：Night workers have days the poster assumes. Those days do not exist.
exercises.answer: Night workers whose days the poster assumes do not exist.

exercises.q: 用 for whom：Breakfast is a kettle for some people. They still count.
exercises.answer: Anyone for whom breakfast is a kettle still counts.

exercises.q: 用 that 指物：The apple offers fibre. The fibre is slower than a bun.
exercises.answer: The fibre that the apple offers is slower than a bun.

exercises.q: 改错：People who avoids yolks miss protein.
exercises.answer: People who avoid yolks miss protein.

exercises.q: 改错：Anyone for who breakfast is a kettle still counts.
exercises.answer: Anyone for whom breakfast is a kettle still counts.

exercises.q: Staff who ____ unpaid data labour as participation should refuse.
A cook for ____ leftover greens are a wage still packs at dawn.
Campaigns ____ only door is a gym receipt fail the staircase.
The kitchen in ____ a kettle lives outruns a studio.
Those ____ we cannot sample still eat.
Dietitians who ______ price never mentioned olive-oil people only.
The dorm ______ second fridge is a fantasy skipped the tip.
Night buses on ______ workers rely leave at 23:10.
in which 与 where 有时可互换，in which 更正式。
whose 不能指 campaigns。
用 whose：Campaigns have only a gym-receipt door. They fail the staircase.
exercises.answer: Campaigns whose only door is a gym receipt fail the staircase.

exercises.q: 用 in which：A kettle lives in the kitchen. That kitchen outruns a studio.
exercises.answer: The kitchen in which a kettle lives outruns a studio.

exercises.q: 用 whom：We cannot sample those people. They still eat.
exercises.answer: Those whom we cannot sample still eat.

exercises.q: 改错：Staff who treats unpaid labour as participation should refuse.
exercises.answer: Staff who treat unpaid labour as participation should refuse.

exercises.q: 改错：The kitchen in where a kettle lives outruns a studio.
exercises.answer: The kitchen in which / where a kettle lives outruns a studio.
exercises.explain: in which 或 where，不要 in where。

exercises.q: Markets that ____ shame to finish a sentence have a lighting budget.
exercises.explain: that 指物，动词复数? markets 复数 hire。

exercises.q: Grandmothers on ____ the service relies were never hired.
A feed ____ calculator never enters the shop distorts portions.
The first sentence in ____ waistlines appear has already left the canteen.
None of those ____ chopping is invisible are failing.
Auditors who ______ canteens before pyramids hear better numbers.
Institutions ______ posters cannot talk back from a kitchen prefer them.
Fields against ______ hashtags race still grow rice.
of those whom 与 of those who 都可能，但介词后用 whom。
that 可放在介词后代替 which。
用 on whom：The service relies on grandmothers. They were never hired.
exercises.answer: Grandmothers on whom the service relies were never hired.

exercises.q: 用 whose：A feed's calculator never enters the shop. It distorts portions.
exercises.answer: A feed whose calculator never enters the shop distorts portions.

exercises.q: 用 in which：Waistlines appear in the first sentence. It has left the canteen.
exercises.answer: The first sentence in which waistlines appear has already left the canteen.

exercises.q: 改错：Grandmothers on who the service relies were never hired.
exercises.answer: Grandmothers on whom the service relies were never hired.

exercises.q: 改错：The sentence in that waistlines appear has left the canteen.
exercises.answer: The sentence in which waistlines appear has left the canteen.

exercises.q: Bodies that ____ the sample still demand fruit at midnight.
exercises.explain: that 复数 missed/miss。宜用 miss。

exercises.q: A courtroom for ____ English must survive will not hear brochure yolk-fear.
Syllabi ____ first mineral is phosphorus and last cook is nobody nourish no one.
The commons in ____ a storehouse becomes a shop has a paywall.
Those ____ we fed last are the test, not the average ghost.
Scholars who ______ density over camera counts still eat.
A PDF ______ dinner is theoretical cannot be digested after a shift.
Onions with ______ kitchens draw on science remain unlisted.
whose 可连接无生命的 syllabi。
whom 只用于限制性从句。
用 whose：A PDF's dinner is theoretical. It cannot be digested after a shift.
exercises.answer: A PDF whose dinner is theoretical cannot be digested after a shift.

exercises.q: 用 for which：English must survive for a courtroom. It will not hear yolk-fear.
exercises.answer: A courtroom for which English must survive will not hear brochure yolk-fear.

exercises.q: 用 whom：We fed those people last. They are the test.
exercises.answer: Those whom we fed last are the test.

exercises.q: 改错：Syllabi who first mineral is phosphorus nourish no one.
exercises.answer: Syllabi whose first mineral is phosphorus nourish no one.

exercises.q: 改错：A courtroom for whom English must survive...（法庭非人）
exercises.answer: A courtroom for which English must survive will not hear brochure yolk-fear.

grammar.title: 现在完成时再探：节食结果、持续、first time、短暂动词
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect: diet results, duration, first time vs When
grammar.usage:
现在完成时 have/has + pp：已发生且与现在相关。I have lost two kilos. She has been on a diet since May.

拓展：already/yet/just；for/since；been vs gone；现在完成进行 have been walking；与过去时 when/ago 对照；短暂动词不与 for 表持续。
forms: This is the first time + 完成
notes: join/come 不与 for 表持续。

examples.en: I have already eaten the soup.
examples.cn: 我已经喝了汤。

examples.en: She has been on a diet for two weeks.
examples.cn: 她节食两周了。

examples.en: This is the first time he has sat up without hands.
examples.cn: 这是他第一次不用手坐起来。

examples.en: Night kitchens have long been missing from the sample.
examples.cn: 夜间厨房早已不在样本里。

examples.en: No knife-skill workshop has yet been funded.
examples.cn: 刀工工作坊尚未获得资助。

examples.en: Kitchens have drawn on onions for centuries.
examples.cn: 厨房几个世纪以来一直在用洋葱。

exercises.q: I ____ already eaten the soup.
She ____ been on a diet for two weeks.
____ you ever boiled an egg?
They haven't packed fruit ____.
We ____ eggs yesterday, not this morning.
He has ______ water since PE.
I have lived here ______ 2022.
How long ______ she had this lunchbox?
for 接一段，since 接起点。
I have eaten soup yesterday 正确。
用完成：The soup is gone. I ate it (result).
用 How long：She has been on a diet for two weeks.
exercises.answer: How long has she been on a diet?

exercises.q: 用过去：I have bought eggs yesterday.
改错：She have been on a diet.
exercises.answer: She has been on a diet.

exercises.q: 改错：Have he ever boiled an egg?
exercises.answer: Has he ever boiled an egg?

exercises.q: Small walks ____ already added up to fewer buses.
I ____ been walking after dinner all month.
This is the first time he ____ sat up without hands.
When ____ you join the gym? — In March.
She has ____ to the canteen; she isn't back.
They have ______ three apples a day since Monday.
I have been ______ the label past the first adjective.
How many times ______ she packed eggs this week?
This is the first time 后用现在完成。
gone to 表示去过已回。
用 first time：He has never sat up without hands.
exercises.answer: This is the first time he has sat up without hands.

exercises.q: 用 been：She went to the canteen and came back.
exercises.answer: She has been to the canteen.

exercises.q: 用 when 过去：You have joined the gym in March.
exercises.answer: You joined the gym in March.

exercises.q: 改错：Small walks has added up.
改错：This is the first time he sat up without hands.
exercises.answer: This is the first time he has sat up without hands.

exercises.q: In the last few years eggs ____ remained a staple.
By now nobody ____ given up Friday pizza entirely.
He has ____ the club for two years. (duration — fix verb)
How long ____ carbohydrates been treated as an enemy?
When ____ the yolk become a magazine villain? — Last decade.
Fibre has ______ cheaper than powder all along.
They have been ______ yolks out of fear.
So far the kettle ______ outrun the capsule.
join 不能与 for two years 表持续。
last decade 作为 when 的答案配现在完成。
用 been in 改正：He has joined the club for two years.
exercises.answer: He has been in the club for two years.

exercises.q: 用 by now：Up to this moment nobody has given up Friday pizza.
exercises.answer: By now nobody has given up Friday pizza.

exercises.q: 用 in the last few years：Eggs remained a staple recently (period open).
exercises.answer: Eggs have remained a staple in the last few years.

exercises.q: 改错：He has joined the gym for two years.
exercises.answer: He has been in the gym for two years. / been a member

exercises.q: 改错：When have the yolk become a villain? — Last decade.
exercises.answer: When did the yolk become a villain? — Last decade.

exercises.q: Night kitchens ____ long been missing from the sample.
This is the only week the canteen ____ posted prices.
I ____ been trying to pack a breakfast that survives a bag.
When ____ unpaid grandmothers become the service? — Quietly, years ago.
No second fridge ____ yet arrived in the dorm.
They have ______ selling a gym receipt as a pulse.
How long ______ time to eat been treated as a hobby?
Up to now the poster ______ not named a cheap fibre source.
完成进行强调未完成过程。
yet 只用于过去时。
用完成进行：They started selling receipts as pulses and still do.
exercises.answer: They have been selling a gym receipt as a pulse.

exercises.q: 用 yet：A second fridge has not arrived in the dorm (until now).
exercises.answer: No second fridge has yet arrived in the dorm.

exercises.q: 用 when 过去：Unpaid grandmothers have become the service years ago.
exercises.answer: Unpaid grandmothers became the service years ago.

exercises.q: 改错：Night kitchens has long been missing.
exercises.answer: Night kitchens have long been missing.

exercises.q: 改错：When have they become the service? — Years ago.
exercises.answer: When did they become the service? — Years ago.

exercises.q: Over the last administration fruit ____ been optional in the budget.
Critics have ____ warning that calories are a poor currency.
No workshop on knife skills ____ yet been funded.
When ____ shame get hired to finish the sentence? — At checkout.
In recent decades yolks ____ outlasted more than one panic.
Hashtags have ______ outrunning fields.
How many PDFs ______ failed to become dinners?
By now the average ghost ______ eaten enough salad for a poster.
over the last administration 接到现在，常用完成。
in recent decades 必须配过去时。
用完成被动：Nobody has funded a knife-skill workshop yet.
exercises.answer: No knife-skill workshop has yet been funded.

exercises.q: 用完成进行：Critics started warning years ago and still warn.
exercises.answer: Critics have been warning for years.

exercises.q: 用 when 过去：Shame has got hired at checkout.
改错：Fruit have been optional in the budget.
exercises.answer: Fruit has been optional in the budget.

exercises.q: 改错：When have shame get hired? — At checkout.
exercises.answer: When did shame get hired? — At checkout.

exercises.q: The ones who missed the sample ____ always eaten, with or without a ghost.
No administration ____ yet digested hunger as more than incidental.
Scholars have ____ treating density as the stubborn predictor.
When ____ naming part from nourishing? — When the egg left the syllabus.
For centuries kitchens ____ drawn on onions the way states claim to draw on science.
A PDF has never ______ a dinner after a ten-hour shift.
They have been ______ phosphorus without listing a cook.
How long ______ fruit been optional at midnight?
for centuries 配现在完成，把习惯接到现在。
always 不能与完成时连用。
用完成被动：Nobody has digested hunger as more than incidental.
exercises.answer: Hunger has not yet been digested as more than incidental.

exercises.q: 用 for centuries：Kitchens drew on onions from long ago until now.
exercises.answer: Kitchens have drawn on onions for centuries.

exercises.q: 用 when 过去：Naming has parted from nourishing when the egg left.
exercises.answer: Naming parted from nourishing when the egg left the syllabus.

exercises.q: 改错：No administration have yet digested hunger.
exercises.answer: No administration has yet digested hunger.

exercises.q: 改错：When have naming part from nourishing? — When the egg left.
exercises.answer: When did naming part from nourishing? — When the egg left.

grammar.title: 动名词作主语：饮食行为当主语（辨 It is...to do、接 doing 的动词）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as subject in food/health contexts; verbs + doing
grammar.usage:
动名词作主语：Eating eggs in moderation is a smart choice. 谓语单数。

拓展：It is adj. to do；look forward to doing；enjoy/finish/suggest/delay/risk + doing；复合结构；Not doing；being done。课文里 smart consumption 虽是名词，仍按“行为当主语”教。
notes: 主语 -ing 用 is 不是 are。

examples.en: Eating eggs is cheap and useful.
examples.cn: 吃鸡蛋便宜又有用。

examples.en: Joining a gym is optional; joining the stairs is free.
examples.cn: 办卡可选；加入楼梯免费。

examples.en: Smart consumption means eating eggs in moderation.
examples.cn: 明智食用意味着适量吃蛋。

examples.en: Packing a breakfast that survives a bag is a night-shift skill.
examples.cn: 打包能在包里活下来的早餐是夜班技能。

examples.en: Putting waistlines in sentence one leaves the canteen behind.
examples.cn: 把腰围放进第一句，就把食堂抛在后面。

examples.en: Listing phosphorus without a cook confuses naming with nourishing.
examples.cn: 列出磷却不列出厨师，是把命名和滋养搞混。

exercises.q: ____ eggs is cheap and useful.
Walking after dinner ____ me ten minutes.
It is easy ____ boil an egg.
____ breakfast makes maths harder.
Not ____ water after PE is unwise.
______ soup first helps you eat less fried food.
It is important ______ sit up slowly.
Swimming ______ good when your knees are sore?（is）
动名词主语用单数谓语。
Eat eggs is cheap 正确。
用 V-ing：It is cheap to eat eggs.
用 It is：To boil an egg is easy.
exercises.answer: It is easy to boil an egg.

exercises.q: 用 Not：Drinking no water after PE is unwise.
exercises.answer: Not drinking water after PE is unwise.

exercises.q: 改错：Eat eggs is cheap.
改错：Walking after dinner take ten minutes.
exercises.answer: Walking after dinner takes ten minutes.

exercises.q: Joining a gym ____ optional; joining the stairs is free.
We look forward to ____ leftover greens into fried rice.
She enjoys ____ labels past the first adjective.
It is unfair ____ shame a hungry stomach.
Not ____ soup leaves room for a second fried plate.
They suggested ______ with an apple.
______ around during calls burns mood.
He finished ______ the lunchbox before the bell.
look forward to 接 doing。
enjoy 接 to do。
用 look forward to：I want to turn leftovers into fried rice (happily).
exercises.answer: I look forward to turning leftovers into fried rice.

exercises.q: 用 suggest doing：They suggested that we start with an apple.
exercises.answer: They suggested starting with an apple.

exercises.q: 用 It is：Shaming a hungry stomach is unfair.
exercises.answer: It is unfair to shame a hungry stomach.

exercises.q: 改错：We look forward to turn leftovers into rice.
exercises.answer: We look forward to turning leftovers into rice.

exercises.q: 改错：Joining a gym are optional.
Smart consumption ____ eating eggs in moderation, not never.
____ all carbohydrates before a test is a way to fail with virtue.
They delayed ____ the yolk a villain until the magazine paid.
It is dishonest ____ sell a gym receipt as a pulse.
Being ____ by a scale every morning is a poorer ritual than water.
She admitted ______ Friday pizza.
______ a protein bar that costs more than lunch is costume.
I don't mind ______ the stairs if the lift is right there.
delay/admit/mind 接 doing。
being done 不能作主语。
用 being：It is poor to be woken by a scale.
exercises.answer: Being woken by a scale is a poorer ritual than water.

exercises.q: 用 delay doing：They delayed the moment they called the yolk a villain.
exercises.answer: They delayed calling the yolk a villain.

exercises.q: 用 V-ing：It means eating eggs in moderation.
exercises.answer: Smart consumption means eating eggs in moderation.
exercises.explain: means doing 已在句中；或 Eating eggs... is smart consumption。

exercises.q: 改错：They delayed to call the yolk a villain.
exercises.answer: They delayed calling the yolk a villain.

exercises.q: 改错：Cutting carbohydrates are virtuous failure.
exercises.answer: Cutting carbohydrates is a way to fail with virtue.

exercises.q: Packing a breakfast that survives a bag ____ a night-shift skill.
____ unpaid grandmothers a service is borrowing, not funding.
The committee postponed ____ knife skills until never.
It is naive ____ start public diet advice at steak.
The monitor's ____ soup wrecked the main course. (skip)
They avoided ______ price on the pyramid.
______ consulted last is the night canteen's fate.（Being）
I remember ______ the kettle before the capsule.
复合结构可用 N's + doing。
postpone 接 to do。
用复合结构：That the monitor skipped soup wrecked the main course.
exercises.answer: The monitor's skipping soup wrecked the main course.

exercises.q: 用 postpone doing：They put off funding knife skills.
用 It is：Starting public advice at steak is naive.
exercises.answer: It is naive to start public diet advice at steak.

exercises.q: 改错：They postponed to fund knife skills.
改错：Packing a surviving breakfast are a skill.
exercises.answer: Packing a breakfast that survives a bag is a night-shift skill.

exercises.q: Hiring shame to finish a sentence ____ a lighting budget, not a kitchen.
____ waistlines in sentence one leaves the canteen behind.
They risk ____ fields if they only fund hashtags.
It is theatrical ____ launch a purity panic after every yolk.
Having ____ fruit optional, the budget still claimed health. (make)
The market denied ______ in moderation.
______ mistaken for glucose is lighting's fate.（Being）
I regret ______ canteens after pyramids.
risk/deny/regret(已发生) 接 doing。
Having made 不能作状语。
用 having done：After they made fruit optional, the budget claimed health.
exercises.answer: Having made fruit optional, the budget still claimed health.

exercises.q: 用 risk doing：If they only fund hashtags, they may lose fields.
exercises.answer: They risk losing fields if they only fund hashtags.

exercises.q: 用 V-ing：It leaves the canteen behind to put waistlines first.
exercises.answer: Putting waistlines in sentence one leaves the canteen behind.

exercises.q: 改错：They risk to lose fields.
改错：Hiring shame are a lighting budget.
exercises.answer: Hiring shame is a lighting budget.

exercises.q: Listing phosphorus without a cook ____ naming with nourishing.
____ a PDF for a dinner will not survive a shift.
Institutions risk ____ the ones who missed the sample.
It is advertising ____ call a storehouse a commons behind a paywall.
The city's ____ onions while claiming science is the tell. (skipping)
They denied ______ hunger incidental.
______ practised in kettles, moderation outlasts panics.（Being / Having been）
I regret ______ the egg from the syllabus.
动名词主语仍视为单数，即使意义像复数行为。
risk starving 不合法，必须 risk to starve。
用 V-ing：It confuses naming with nourishing to list phosphorus without a cook.
exercises.answer: Listing phosphorus without a cook confuses naming with nourishing.

exercises.q: 用 risk doing：They may starve those who missed the sample.
exercises.answer: They risk starving the ones who missed the sample.

exercises.q: 用复合：That the city skips onions while claiming science is the tell.
exercises.answer: The city's skipping onions while claiming science is the tell.

exercises.q: 改错：Listing phosphorus without a cook confuse naming.
exercises.answer: Listing phosphorus without a cook confuses naming.

exercises.q: 改错：They risk to starve the ones who missed the sample.
exercises.answer: They risk starving the ones who missed the sample.

grammar.title: 情态建议再谱：should / had better / must / have to / don't have to（饮食场景）
grammar.titleEn: should, had better, must, have to, don't have to in diet advice
grammar.usage:
建议情态：should / ought to / had better；Why don't you；could。课文用比较级暗示建议：eggs are a healthier option ≈ you should choose eggs.

拓展：must/have to 义务；mustn't 禁止；don't have to 不必；need to；be supposed to。
饮食：You should start with soup. You don't have to give up pizza. You must not skip water after PE.
forms: must not vs don't have to
be supposed to / have got to
notes: Need I 无 to；need to 有 to。

examples.en: You should start with soup.
examples.cn: 你应该先喝汤。

examples.en: You don't have to join a gym.
examples.cn: 你不必办健身卡。

examples.en: You must not sell a gym receipt as a pulse.

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句：逗号 + which/who/whom/whose（不用 that）
grammar.titleEn: Non-defining relative clauses; which not that; preposition + which/whom
grammar.usage:
非限制性定语从句补充额外信息，用逗号隔开，删了主句仍完整。Eggs, which many people avoid out of fear, are a smart choice.

规则：不用 that；指物用 which；指人用 who/whom；介词+which/whom；as 也可引导。
限制性无逗号、信息必要；非限制性有逗号、信息附加。
forms: 限制性 vs 非限制性（有无逗号）
notes: 物用 which 不用 that。
从句动词与先行词一致。

examples.cn: 每天晚上煮汤的妈妈讨厌浪费。

grammar.title: 过去分词作形容词与被动：boiled / balanced / digested / -ed vs -ing
grammar.titleEn: Past participles as adjectives; be/get + pp; -ed vs -ing
grammar.usage:
过去分词作形容词或构成被动：boiled eggs, a balanced diet, eggs are easily digested.

-ed 表“已经/被动/状态”；-ing 表“令人/正在”。tired vs tiring。
被动 be + pp：is digested。get-passive：get burnt。
复合：high-fibre, water-soluble。
不要把不及物当成被动。
notes: I am tired, the class is tiring。
boiled 不是 boiling（若指煮好的）。

examples.en: I like boiled eggs, not fried ones.
examples.cn: 我喜欢煮蛋，不喜欢煎的。

examples.en: A balanced diet includes soup and sleep.
examples.cn: 均衡饮食包括汤和睡眠。

examples.en: Eggs are more gently digested than many people fear.
examples.cn: 鸡蛋的消化比许多人担心的更温和。

examples.cn: 橄榄油建议是为另一个邮编写的。

examples.cn: PDF 是一顿未被消化的晚饭。
